featured_reviews.name: Genevie Serrao
featured_reviews.review_text: I am from Vidyavihar and came here to learn how to ride a scooty. It was a truly wonderful experience. I felt completely at home, as if I were part of a family. Both sir and ma’am guided us with patience and taught us how to ride confidently within just 15 days.

featured_reviews.name: Darsh Nath Segal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took their 15 days package (5 days - scooty+ 10 days - bike). It was very helpful, I not just learnt how to ride both, but developed confidence as well through practice.

Bobby really helped me understand the nuances behind riding a bike - clutch control, gear shifting, pillon riding etc.

Would really recommend it if you have no idea on how to ride a bike and want to get started with the basics till the advanced levels.

featured_reviews.name: Chirag Narvekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I joined the two-wheeler training as a complete beginner with no cycling knowledge. The instructor was very patient and guided me step by step from basics to road riding. Within just 15 days, I gained confidence and learned to ride independently. It was a great learning experience, and I highly recommend it to beginners.

featured_reviews.name: Pragati Nilesh vaja
featured_reviews.review_text: As a non-cyclist, I joined ovi training school to learn how to ride a Activa, and my experience was excellent.
